statement:
Tomas Vega cancelled his Fitline membership on 3 July and the club confirmed it. Since the membership is no longer active, I will refuse the charge.
[handle_payment(value='refuse', id='RP-88')]
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "Since the membership is no longer active," contradicting the record's "Membership: active, renewing" and refusing the charge on that basis.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
